# Lose Weight Today

> Lose Weight Today is the website of Jaffa and Dan Leffler, Herbalife Independent Members based in Caulfield North, Melbourne, Australia. They offer Herbalife nutrition products, personalised weight-management coaching, and the Herbalife business opportunity, with Australia-wide online ordering.

## About

- Website: https://www.loseweighttoday.com.au/
- Distributors: Jaffa and Dan Leffler — Herbalife Independent Members since 1993, Senior Executive Presidents 15K
- Location: 23 Salisbury Street, Caulfield North, VIC 3161, Australia (walk-in 7 days, 9am-8pm)
- Phone: 0478 965 828
- Contact email: leffleryd@gmail.com
- Service area: Melbourne, with online ordering Australia-wide

## What we offer

### Herbalife Nutrition Products
Formula 1 shakes, protein nutrition, multivitamins, weight-management programs, sports nutrition, and targeted supplements, ordered through the official Herbalife online store.

### Personalised Weight-Loss Coaching
Free wellness evaluations and personalised nutrition plans, with ongoing coaching support from Jaffa and Dan Leffler.

### Herbalife Business Opportunity
Information and support for people interested in becoming a Herbalife Independent Member, including low-cost membership and a 90-day money-back guarantee.
